import importlib
import semver.version
importlib.reload(semver.version)
from semver.version import Version

# Test m2 observables
v1 = Version.parse('1.2.3+alpha')
result1 = v1.bump_build()
print("bump_build alpha:", repr(result1.build), "== 'alpha.0':", result1.build == 'alpha.0')

v2 = Version.parse('1.2.3+build.9')
result2 = v2.bump_build()
print("bump_build build.9:", repr(result2.build), "== 'build.10':", result2.build == 'build.10')

# Also test normal cases still work
v3 = Version.parse('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9')
result3 = v3.bump_build()
print("bump_build rc.1+build.9:", repr(result3.build))

v4 = Version.parse('3.4.5')
result4 = v4.bump_build()
print("bump_build no build (default token):", repr(result4.build))

v5 = Version.parse('3.4.5')
result5 = v5.bump_build(token="dev")
print("bump_build no build (token='dev'):", repr(result5.build))
